 Download Now CBSE Intermediate, matric session 1 exam dates soon (Representative Image: Pexels) The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) is expected to announce the exam dates for the Class 10 and Class 12 board examinations 2027 soon. Students appearing for the board exam will be able to download the subject-wise CBSE date sheet and timing on the official website, cbse.gov.in. Based on previous years' trends, the examinations are expected to be held in February and March, and CBSE datesheet is expected in October.

 CBSE Board Exam 2027 for private candidates
 CBSE has opened the application process for private candidates appearing for the Class 10 and Class 12 board examinations in 2027. The application and fee submission window will remain open until October 23, 2026.
 The board will conclude the List of Candidates (LOC) submission process for regular students appearing for the Class 10 and Class 12 board examinations in 2027. Schools that miss the deadline can submit the details between October 22 and October 30 by paying a late fee of Rs 2,000 per candidate.
 Corrections to candidates' names, parents' or guardians' names and dates of birth can be done between November 2 and 4.
 Also read For every 100 boys, only 59 girls in rural India complete Class 12: UNESCO Report 
 CBSE Board Exam 2027: Steps to download date sheet PDF
 Once CBSE publishes the Class 10 and Class 12 timetable, students can follow these steps to download it:
 Go to the official CBSE website, cbse.gov.in
 On homepage, look for the latest announcements section
 Click on the link for CBSE Class 10 or Class 12 date sheet 2027
 Examination timetable PDF will appear on the screen
 Download the same and save it for future references
 Students appearing for CBSE Class 10 and Class 12 board examinations must secure at least 33% marks in each subject to pass. Class 10 students can appear in session 2 to improve their scores in up to 3 subjects. Class 12 students will have an option of appearing in supplementary exams in case they fail to secure passing marks in main board exams.

 CBSE Class 10 Date Sheet 2027 Soon: Rules for two board exams
 The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) introduced the two-board examination system for Class 10 in 2026 and has clarified the eligibility criteria for appearing in the second examination.
 First exam mandatory: Students must appear in the first board examination to be eligible for the second exam.
 Attendance requirement: Students who miss three or more subjects in the first examination will not be eligible to appear in the second exam.
 Improvement option: Students who pass the first examination can opt to improve their marks in up to three subjects, subject to CBSE's eligibility criteria.
